draftArchitecture.openingJob: Report the select-US-advertiser test and the user’s choice to enter a separate sponsored conversation.
causalSequence: A person sees and clicks a ChatGPT ad.
The person chooses whether to start a clearly labelled business-sponsored agent conversation.
The seller conversation remains separate from the original chat and independent answers.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: Ask a lamp seller for dimensions and return terms, then compare those claims with the product page.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: At any conversational ad hand-off, identify the speaker and its incentive.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Notice the label before asking product questions; compare seller claims with the product page.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: The Story; LAiDIES Read; What This Means for You; Cocktail Party; Class Notes.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: No fictional shopper, workplace example, provider dining-table example, privacy inference or generic AI-commerce panorama.
